spots.name: Which Way
spots.blurb: You've reached Which Way, a mural by Joanna White. "Which Way is meant to appear as if it belongs here, it's intended to be playful as well as intriguing, to reflect the idea of inclusion and allow for individual stories.".

spots.name: Parade Mural
spots.blurb: You've reached Parade Mural, a mural by Outside Exhibition Group. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
